content.short: African digital bank with personal and business products.
content.description: Kuda is a leading African digital bank, often called the money app for Africans, serving millions of personal and business customers from its bases in Nigeria and the UK. Through its app it offers free and low-fee current accounts, debit cards, instant transfers, savings and budgeting tools, overdrafts, and bill payments, plus dedicated business banking for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Kuda targets Africans at home and in the diaspora who want accessible, mobile-first banking without the fees and friction of traditional banks, and it has expanded toward remittances and cross-border services for Nigerians abroad. By combining everyday accounts, cards, and credit at scale, Kuda has become one of the most recognizable neobanks on the continent.
